name: Checkout Summary
description: A commerce order summary with totals, taxes, discounts, and trust metadata.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements in Checkout Summary templates before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Interactive descendants must be reachable by keyboard and expose visible focus.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Standalone
examples.notes: Consumer-authored reference, no automatic prop binding. Prefix IDs before repeating.

binding.html: li children with label and formatted price

items.contract: Consumer data. Render labels as text and content through the documented semantic child/slot structure; never insert untrusted HTML.

binding.html: dt/dd subtotal, tax and total; consumer supplies formatted currency

default.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

compact.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

sticky.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

guidance.use: Display items and a definition list of totals with checkout actions.
guidance.avoid: Payment processing or automatic totals computation.

items.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.

totals.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.

actions.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.
